reviews.text: My personal color is soft summer, so I ask Gemini to recommend the color for me, and it says this! Turns out this is actually the perfect “blush” blush color for me! There’s shimmer in the stick, but it doesn’t really show on the skin. It has a dewy finish which is perfect if the natural look is what you’re looking for! But if not set with any kind of powder, it does wear off in a short period of time… If set with powder, it takes away the dewy finish… so….🤣Can always reply through the day, doesn’t lift off the makeup underneath, but just too lazy to do that…
reviews.zh: 我個人嘅膚色係 soft summer，所以我叫 Gemini 幫我推薦色號，佢就推薦咗呢支！結果呢支真係最適合我嘅「胭脂」胭脂色！棒入面係有閃粉嘅，但係上咗皮膚之後其實睇唔出嚟。妝效係水光，如果想追求自然妝感就啱晒！但係如果唔用任何碎粉定妝，妝真係好快就會甩… 一用碎粉定妝，水光感就會消失… 所以….🤣其實日間可以隨時補，唔會推起底下嘅妝，只係我太懶唔想做…

reviews.text:
This balm is very glossy and pretty. It has no glitter in it, which i appreciate for days where i want a more natural skin glow. A little goes a long way, and it is very reflective. It is not long lasting, but I would never expect a balm like this to be so. Luckily, the packaging is compact and quality, so it is easy to carry in your purse. 
Also, if your hair is down, you may have some flyaways stick to the product

Protip: Do not swipe directly onto the face to apply, because that will remove your base. Highly recommend applying by tapping with a dense brush. i have it applied to my cheekbone and brow bone
reviews.zh:
呢支 balm 嘅光澤感好靚好靚。佢冇閃粉，我想追求自然皮膚光澤感嘅日子就最啱。少量已經好夠用，而且反光效果好強。持久度唔高，但係我從來都唔期望呢類 balm 會持久。好彩包裝細緻有質素，放落袋都好方便。
另外，如果頭髮放落嚟，可能會有啲碎髮黐住產品

貼士：唔好直接咁掃上面，因為會推走底妝。強烈建議用密實嘅掃以輕拍方式上妝。我係用喺顴骨同眉骨位置。

reviews.text: Gives you the glow that kpop idols have. It’s not sticky at all and its very moisturizing. So be careful when you apply it onto of your foundation otherwise it’ll move your base. I’m so excited to try this balm during summer cause it’s the perfect balm for glowy clean girl makeup😆.I tried this balm on top of my foundation and it didn’t move my base and blended so well into my skin and for the longevity idk yet… I’ll try later.
reviews.zh: 用完皮膚可以好似 kpop 偶像咁有光澤。完全唔黏笠，而且非常保濕。不過搽上面嗰陣要小心，如果直接搽喺粉底上面，會推走底妝。好期待夏天用呢支 balm，因為佢真係最適合水光 clean girl 妝😆。我試過搽喺粉底上面，冇推走底妝，同皮膚融合得好好，至於持久度我而家仲未知… 遲啲再試。

reviews.text: I enjoy this highlighting balm, it is more natural than a lot of highlighters out there but still provides a radiance and beautiful look to the skin. The twist up and down stick format is easy to use and travel with. On the arm swatch, Light is on the left and Gleaming is on the right. I think Light is better for everyday and is good even on bare skin whilst Gleaming is nice when you have pink/purple tone makeup on. You definitely don’t need both as the difference is pretty subtle.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支 highlight balm，比起市面上好多 highlight 更加自然，但係依然可以畀到皮膚光澤感同靚嘅妝效。扭出扭入嘅棒狀設計用起上嚟方便，帶出街都好方便。手臂試色上面，Light 喺左邊，Gleaming 喺右邊。我覺得 Light 更加適合日常使用，就算素顏都用得；而 Gleaming 就比較啱配襯粉紅／紫色調嘅妝。兩個其實唔使兩支都買，因為分別真係好細。

reviews.text: After hearing all the hype about this product, I was a bit disappointed with its performance. The balm is a bit smaller than a rom&nd lip gloss and the glow doesn’t illuminate that “glass-skin” look as much as I thought it would. The glow very subtle, but it does do its job. I wouldn’t buy it again though.
reviews.zh: 聽咗咁多好評之後用呢支產品，感覺有啲失望。支 balm 比起 rom&nd 唇彩細小，而且光澤感冇我預期咁做到「玻璃肌」效果。雖然光澤好淡，但係基本功能都做到。只不過我就唔會再買。

reviews.text: Dawn Ray has a slight color and depending on your skintone you won't need a blush underneath. This is one of the best Highlighters that I have tried. The glow is insane and stays on the whole day. Use a setting spray to intensify the results and warm up the product with your finger and lightly dab it onto your skin.
reviews.zh: Dawn Ray 有少少顏色，要視乎你嘅膚色決定需唔需要再打底胭脂。呢支係我用過其中一支最好嘅 highlight。光澤感勁到爆，而且可以維持成日。用定妝噴霧可以加強效果，記得用手指暖返支產品再輕輕拍上面。

reviews.text:
I have been looking for a dupe for the Chanel stick highlighter for a long time, but the others I have tried often have too much glitter and color. I decided to try out the Hince stick in #05 light and the Holika Holika stick. 

This one is the stiffest stick out of the three, and at first, I did not like this and preferred the other two. However, as the temperature got hotter, the other sticks became softer, and the sticks break off when you try to apply them. The Hince one didn't do this as the formula is not as soft. (I live in a country that is not that hot, if you live in a hot and humid country go for Hince)

There is a slight color to the Hince one, it works well on my skin, and it probably will work well on light to medium skin tones. If you have a deep skin tone, the color might show up and it will look more like a traditional highlight and not a natural glow. If you are looking for a natural look and have a deep skin ton go for #01 or #03

It lasts well for a cream highlight.
reviews.zh:
我一直都喺度搵 Chanel 支裝 highlight 嘅代替品，之前試過嘅其他支裝 highlight 多數閃粉同顏色都太重。最後我決定試 Hince 支裝嘅 #05 light 同 Holika Holika 嘅支裝 highlight。

呢支係三支入面最硬嘅，初初我唔鍾意呢支，反而鍾意其餘兩支。但係天氣越嚟越熱，其餘兩支嘅膏體就變軟，上妝嗰陣會斷。Hince 嗰支就冇呢個問題，因為配方冇咁軟。（我住嘅國家唔算好熱，如果你住喺又熱又濕嘅地方就揀 Hince）

Hince 嗰支有少少顏色，喺我皮膚上面效果好好，我相信淺至中等膚色都會適合。如果係深色膚色，顏色可能會太明顯，望落會好似傳統 highlight 嗰種，而唔係自然光澤。如果你想要自然妝感又係深色膚色，可以揀 #01 或者 #03。

作為一支 cream highlight，佢嘅持久度係好嘅。

reviews.text:
クリアカラーは、ラメやカラーなどはなく艶だけをプラスしてくれます。
シンプルで使いやすく、公式写真にもあるように瞼等につけるのもお勧めです。(※写真引用させていただいてます)
みずみずしく、パウダーハイライトとは、また違った楽しみ方ができます♪

バームなのでヨレが気になるかな〜と思ったのですが、意外とヨレないです！部分的に保湿された感覚です💭
ただ塗りすぎると、ただテカッてるだけになってしまうので要注意です。。
パールの艶ではなく、自然なうる艶感を出したい方にはCLEARを。皮脂過多の方や、パール感が欲しい方にはLIGHTをお勧めします。
どちらもとってもかわいいので、どっちを購入しても後悔はしないと思います！
reviews.zh:
Clear 呢個色冇閃粉、冇顏色，只係加添光澤感。
簡單易用，好似官方相入面咁樣，建議可以搽喺眼蓋等位置。(※相片引用自官方)
質地水潤，同碎粉 highlight 比係另一種享受♪

本來以為 balm 容易卡粉，點知原來唔太會卡！局部有保濕嘅感覺💭
不過如果搽太多，就只會變成油光，所以要留意。。
如果唔想要珠光感，想有自然水潤光澤嘅朋友揀 CLEAR。想多啲油光或者想要珠光感嘅朋友就揀 LIGHT。
兩支都好可愛，所以揀邊支都唔會後悔！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
